tables.name: candle_field_notes
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE candle_field_notes (
    exchange    TEXT NOT NULL,
    market      TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol      TEXT NOT NULL,
    timeframe   TEXT NOT NULL,
    field       TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 缺失字段名，如 taker_buy_volume
    stored_as   TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 实际落库表示（'' 空串 / NULL）
    reason      TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 缺失原因
    impact      TEXT,               -- 对下游的影响，如「B 策略数据不足」
    source      TEXT,
    updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(exchange, market, symbol, timeframe, field)
)

tables.name: candle_heads
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "candle_heads" (
    exchange TEXT NOT NULL, market TEXT NOT NULL, symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    timeframe TEXT NOT NULL, open_time INTEGER NOT NULL, source_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(exchange, market, symbol, timeframe, open_time),
    FOREIGN KEY(exchange, market, symbol, timeframe, open_time, source_id)
      REFERENCES candle_versions(exchange, market, symbol, timeframe, open_time, source_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

tables.name: candle_versions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE candle_versions (
    exchange TEXT NOT NULL, market TEXT NOT NULL, symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    timeframe TEXT NOT NULL, open_time INTEGER NOT NULL, close_time INTEGER NOT NULL,
    open TEXT NOT NULL, high TEXT NOT NULL, low TEXT NOT NULL, close TEXT NOT NULL,
    volume TEXT NOT NULL, quote_volume TEXT NOT NULL, trade_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    taker_buy_volume TEXT NOT NULL, taker_buy_quote_volume TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
    available_at INTEGER, is_closed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_closed = 1),
    PRIMARY KEY(exchange, market, symbol, timeframe, open_time, source_id)
)

tables.name: coverage_cache

tables.name: download_runs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE download_runs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL,          -- pool_snapshot / batch / verify

    started_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,

tables.name: download_tasks
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE download_tasks (
    exchange       TEXT NOT NULL,
    market         TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol         TEXT NOT NULL,
    timeframe      TEXT NOT NULL,
    status         TEXT NOT NULL,       -- done / missing_only / partial / failed / skipped_no_window
    planned_files  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    imported_files INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cached_files   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    missing_files  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    failed_files   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    rows           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    first_open     INTEGER,
    last_close     INTEGER,
    gaps           INTEGER,
    started_at     INTEGER,

tables.name: funding_history
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE funding_history (
    exchange     TEXT NOT NULL,
    market       TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol       TEXT NOT NULL,
    funding_time INTEGER NOT NULL,
    funding_rate TEXT,

    rate_type    TEXT,
    source       TEXT,
    fetched_at   INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY(exchange, market, symbol, funding_time)
)

tables.name: kline_stream_state
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE kline_stream_state (
    exchange              TEXT    NOT NULL,
    market                TEXT    NOT NULL,
    timeframe             TEXT    NOT NULL,
    symbols_planned       INTEGER,
    symbols_seen          INTEGER,
    last_msg_at           INTEGER,   -- 最近一条真实 WS 消息的本机接收时间
    last_closed_open_time INTEGER,   -- 最近一根**已收盘** bar 的 open_time
    last_closed_written_at INTEGER,  -- 该闭合 bar 的入库时间
    last_forming_open_time INTEGER,  -- 当前未收盘 bar 的 open_time
    closed_written        INTEGER,   -- 累计闭合入库根数
    gapfill_calls         INTEGER,   -- 断线后经统一网关补缺的 REST 调用数
    gapfill_filled        INTEGER,   -- 补缺成功写入的根数
    gapfill_skipped       INTEGER,   -- 因预算上限被跳过的 (标的,周期) 数（诚实留证）
    reconnects            INTEGER,
    backoff_s             INTEGER,   -- 当前/最近一次退避秒数
    status                TEXT,      -- ok / no_messages / reconnect_backoff / native_absent
    detail                TEXT,
    updated_at            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(exchange, market, timeframe)
)

tables.name: realtime_klines
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE realtime_klines (
    exchange               TEXT    NOT NULL,
    market                 TEXT    NOT NULL,

tables.name: realtime_quotes
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE realtime_quotes (
    exchange             TEXT NOT NULL,
    market               TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol               TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_price           TEXT,
    price_change_pct_24h TEXT,
    quote_volume_24h     TEXT,     -- 计价（USDT）24h 成交额；**不是**滚动 5m 成交量
    high_24h             TEXT,
    low_24h              TEXT,
    mark_price           TEXT,
    funding_rate         TEXT,     -- 当前费率（非结算事件，结算事件另存 funding_history）
    next_funding_time    INTEGER,
    event_time           INTEGER,  -- 交易所事件时间
    received_at          INTEGER,  -- 本机接收时间
    fetched_at           INTEGER,  -- 本机请求完成时间
    source               TEXT,     -- binance.fapi / okx.v5
    transport            TEXT,     -- ws / rest
    unit_note            TEXT,
    updated_at           INTEGER NOT NULL, price_event_time INTEGER, price_received_at INTEGER, price_source TEXT, price_transport TEXT, mark_event_time INTEGER, mark_source TEXT, funding_event_time INTEGER, funding_source TEXT, volume_24h_base TEXT, volume_24h_contract TEXT, volume_source TEXT, open24h TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY(exchange, market, symbol)
)

tables.name: symbol_classification
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE symbol_classification (
    exchange        TEXT NOT NULL,
    market          TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol          TEXT NOT NULL,
    instrument_category TEXT,          -- COIN / INDEX / EQUITY / ... ；欧易为 1/3/4/5/6
    category_name   TEXT,              -- Crypto / Stocks / Commodities / Forex / Bonds
    category_field  TEXT,              -- 依据字段名（underlyingType / instCategory）
    contract_type   TEXT,
    in_active_range INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- 1=加密币活动范围
    excluded_reason TEXT,
    raw_json        TEXT,              -- 该标的的原始字段（取证）
    snapshot_utc    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    source_call_id  INTEGER,
    updated_at      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(exchange, market, symbol)
)

tables.name: symbol_pool
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE symbol_pool (
    exchange          TEXT NOT NULL,
    market            TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol            TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_type     TEXT,
    quote_asset       TEXT,
    margin_asset      TEXT,
    status            TEXT,
    onboard_time      INTEGER,
    base_asset        TEXT,
    spot_symbol       TEXT,
    spot_status       TEXT,
    spot_match_method TEXT,

tables.name: symbol_supply
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE symbol_supply (
    exchange            TEXT    NOT NULL,
    market              TEXT    NOT NULL,
    symbol              TEXT    NOT NULL,
    base                TEXT,              -- 合约标的币（如 BTC / 1000PEPE），供跨所按币回退匹配
    circulating_supply  TEXT,              -- 官方原值（字符串保精度），单位见 unit_note
    unit_note           TEXT,              -- 单位说明（写明「以合约标的币为单位」）
    source              TEXT,              -- 例如 binance.fapi.openInterestHist
    supply_event_time   INTEGER,           -- 该行在交易所侧的 5m 桶时间（毫秒）
    fetched_at          INTEGER,           -- 本机取到该行的时间
    updated_at          INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(exchange, market, symbol)
)

tables.name: candles
tables.sql:
CREATE VIEW candles AS
SELECT v.* FROM candle_versions v JOIN candle_heads h
USING(exchange, market, symbol, timeframe, open_time, source_id)
